description:
Test and correct PDF documents for accessibility.

axesPDF checks PDF documents against PDF/UA and WCAG accessibility requirements and includes tools for correcting problems.
Improvements
- Improved performance: In our tests, the PDF/UA, WCAG and Quality checks ran about 75% faster.
- Reduced memory consumption: In our tests, the PDF/UA, WCAG and Quality checks used about 60% less memory.
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where axesPDF showed an incorrect warning for form annotations inside paragraph-like structure elements.
- A bug with Entra ID licensing has been fixed.
